spans.s: The twenty-fourth consonant of the Nāgarī alphabet, and aspirate of the last letter, or Bh.

n. (भं)
1 A star.
2 An asterism.
3 A planet.
m. (भः)
1 A name of ŚUKRA, regent of the planet

A bee.
3 Error, delusion.
f. (भा)
1 Light, lustre, splendor.
2 A ray of light.
f. (भी)
Fear.
E.
भा to shine, or भी to fear, aff. ड.

r. 2nd cl. (-भाति)
1 To shine, to be luminous, splendid or beautiful.
2 To be pleased.
3 To be angry.
4 To blow.
5 To be, to exist.
With आङ्,
to flash.
With प्र or वि,
to shine brightly.

The shadow of a gnomon.
m. (भाः)
The sun.
E.
भा to shine, aff. अङ् and टाप्.
